name: Valerias Macron
original_name: ヴァレリアス・マクロン
source:
Although he has a rough and troublesome personality, he is in fact a very caring and dependable big brother figure.
He makes a living as a jack-of-all-trades, but he is always short of money due to his huge appetite.
Contrary to his bombastic appearance, he plays the piano delicately and beautifully.

[Translated from the [url=https://twitter.com/CFGame_veribaro/status/1552957103744204801]official twitter[/url]]
